_comment: Kitchen game (round 4, Food Hygiene). Intro screens and outro texts are the 2009 wording (kitchen_game_intro_level_N.swf, KitchenGame.as:1163-1202) with doubled spaces removed; level 4's time corrected to the 120 s the level gives (decision #12). {click} / {Click} become click or tap for the input in use; the sentences that name a control have .keyboard and .gamepad variants (mouse and keyboard share one device), with {key_*} names from web/js/ui/prompts.js.
kitchen.intro.0.1: In this mini-game, you have to put away the shopping.
kitchen.intro.0.4: You need to put things in the right place.
kitchen.intro.0.6: Vegetables go in the bottom drawer of the fridge.
kitchen.intro.0.7: Drinks and Yogurt go in the fridge door.
kitchen.intro.0.8: On the next screen, {click} on the correct place in the fridge to put away the spring onion.
kitchen.intro.0.8.keyboard: On the next screen, click on the correct place in the fridge (or choose it with {arrowKeys} and press Enter) to put away the spring onion.
kitchen.intro.0.8.gamepad: On the next screen, choose the correct place in the fridge with the d-pad and press {key_jump} to put away the spring onion.
kitchen.intro.0.goal: Try to put away 10 things before the timer runs out.
kitchen.intro.0.ready: {Click} the button when you're ready to start the level...
kitchen.intro.0.ready.keyboard: Click the button (or press Enter) when you're ready to start the level...
kitchen.intro.0.ready.gamepad: Press {key_jump} when you're ready to start the level...
kitchen.intro.1.2: This time, you also have to put away fruit, tins and bread.
kitchen.intro.1.3: Remember, vegetables go in the bottom drawers in the fridge.
kitchen.intro.1.4: Liquids like milk, yogurt and juice go in the fridge door.
kitchen.intro.1.5: There are some new things this time.
kitchen.intro.1.6: If you see fruit, put it in the fruit bowl.
kitchen.intro.1.7: Tins and bread go in the cupboard.
kitchen.intro.1.8: One more thing - if you start to sneeze, {click} on the tissues quick! Otherwise, you'll cover the food in harmful microbes.
kitchen.intro.1.8.keyboard: One more thing - if you start to sneeze, click on the tissues (or press {key_tissues}) quick! Otherwise, you'll cover the food in harmful microbes.
kitchen.intro.1.8.gamepad: One more thing - if you start to sneeze, press {key_camera} for the tissues quick! Otherwise, you'll cover the food in harmful microbes.
kitchen.intro.1.9: {Click} on the button when ready to start.
kitchen.intro.1.9.keyboard: Click on the button (or press Enter) when ready to start.
kitchen.intro.2.2: Things are about to get tricky...
kitchen.intro.2.3: This time, you also have to put away meat.
kitchen.intro.2.4: Meat should always be kept away from vegetables to prevent microbes from spreading.
kitchen.intro.2.5: {Click} on the cling film to cover meat before putting it in the fridge.
kitchen.intro.2.5.keyboard: Click on the cling film (or press {key_clingfilm}) to cover meat before putting it in the fridge.
kitchen.intro.2.5.gamepad: Press {key_fire} for the cling film to cover meat before putting it in the fridge.
kitchen.intro.2.6: Cooked meat has to have its own shelf.
kitchen.intro.2.7: Raw meat needs to have a solid shelf. So put the raw meat on the bottom shelf, above the fridge drawers.
kitchen.intro.2.8: Also, if you find cheese, it goes on the top or middle shelf.
kitchen.intro.3.2: Let's see what you can do.
kitchen.intro.3.3: You know all the rules now.
kitchen.intro.3.4: Can you put away all the food correctly?
kitchen.intro.3.6: You have to put away 20 items.
kitchen.tutorial.hint.touch: Where does the spring onion go? Tap the right place
kitchen.tutorial.hint.keyboard: Where does the spring onion go? {ArrowKeys} or Tab to choose, Enter to put it away
kitchen.tutorial.hint.gamepad: Where does the spring onion go? D-pad to choose, {key_jump} to put it away
kitchen.outro.noMistakes: No microbial mistakes this time. Well done!
kitchen.note.clingfilm: Raw and Cooked meat should be covered before putting away.
kitchen.note.sneeze: If you don't cover your mouth when you sneeze, you can spread harmful microbes.
kitchen.note.sneezeHands: Even if you use a tissue when you sneeze, you should wash your hands before handling food.
kitchen.note.badFood: If food is mouldy or off, you should throw it away.
kitchen.note.burstContainer: If a liquid container is burst you should throw it away.
kitchen.note.cookedMeatShelf: Cooked meat should be covered and placed on its own shelf.
kitchen.note.rawMeatShelf: Raw meat should have a solid shelf all to itself to prevent harmful microbes transferring to other food.
kitchen.note.rawMeatHands: After you handle raw meat, you should wash your hands to prevent harmful microbes from spreading.
kitchen.note.fruitLocation: Fruit should be put in the fruit bowl.
kitchen.note.vegetablesLocation: Vegetables should be put in the bottom drawer in the fridge.
kitchen.note.cheeseLocation: Cheese should go in the top or middle shelf.
kitchen.note.cookedMeatLocation: Cooked Meat should go in the top or middle shelf - and have a shelf all on its own.
kitchen.note.rawMeatLocation: Raw Meat should go on the solid shelf above the drawers.
kitchen.note.liquidsLocation: Liquids should be put in the fridge door.
kitchen.note.cupboardItemsLocation: Things like cans and bread should be put in the cupboard.
kitchen.target.fridgeLower: Fridge: bottom shelf, above the drawers
kitchen.say.sneeze: You are about to sneeze! Use a tissue.
kitchen.say.tissue: You sneezed into a tissue. Wash your hands.
kitchen.done.title: Kitchen complete!
